meta.description: Tests recognition of proxy and intrusion detection functions.

question.text: Which TWO functions may be provided by network security appliances? Select two.
options: A proxy can relay client requests and apply content or access policies
An IDS can detect suspicious traffic and generate alerts
A patch panel assigns IP addresses to endpoints
A repeater performs user authentication against a directory
correctAnswers: A proxy can relay client requests and apply content or access policies
An IDS can detect suspicious traffic and generate alerts
